blogs.title: Breaking Free from Tokens: How BLT Changes the LLM Game
blogs.description: This post explores the fundamental shift from fixed-vocabulary tokenization to raw byte processing. It explains why tokenizers have been a bottleneck for modern AI and how the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) eliminates issues like multilingual inequity and domain sensitivity by learning directly from raw data.

blogs.title: The Entropy Principle: Why AI Should Think Harder About Harder Problems
blogs.description: Focusing on the 'entropy patching' innovation, this piece breaks down how BLT dynamically allocates compute. Instead of treating every word the same, it spends more energy on complex predictions and less on predictable sequences, resulting in up to 50% savings in inference costs.

blogs.title: Beyond the Word: Improving AI's Understanding of Characters and Noise
blogs.description: This post highlights BLT's superior performance on robustness benchmarks. It details how working at the byte level allows the model to handle typos, character manipulation, and low-resource languages better than current token-based giants like Llama 3.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: Bigger Models Without the Slowdown
blogs.description: This article discusses the unique scaling advantages of BLT. It explains how the architecture allows model size and patch size to grow simultaneously while keeping inference costs fixed, unlocking a new path for building larger, more capable models efficiently.
